ACCEPTANCE GAP, raised while this epic is still open. Current test file has 5 blocks, 34 expectations, all passing - and all structural.

  32  learned crossnobis plans execute one exact support-streamed kernel
  82  residual provenance policies share execution but retain identity
  141 invalid training and memory plans fail before residual reads
  192 shrinkage target and calibration limits are explicit
  201 workspace changes execution identity but not the scientific plan

Against your seven acceptance criteria:

  MET      Both policies execute through the same plan with different metric-recipe identities
  MET      Deliberate undeclared evaluation-data access fails before numerical evaluation
  MET      No CI or LD-t view exported until calibration accounts for learned-metric randomness
  NOT MET  Paired simulations report null centering, conditional-target bias,
           population-Mahalanobis bias, variance, RMSE, and Monte Carlo uncertainty
  PARTIAL  Shrinkage-target estimation in provenance AND uncertainty analysis
           (provenance is there; uncertainty analysis is not)
  NOT MET  Results distinguish evaluator correctness from learner quality
  NOT MET  A material policy difference becomes a durable evidence report and follow-up issue

grep for replicate / margin / equival / colMeans / seed in test-crossnobis-learned.R returns nothing, so there is no simulation machinery in this epic at all yet.

This matters more than usual because there IS a material difference to report - see my decision note above, z = -9.81 on the signal arm - so the last criterion is live, not hypothetical. Closing on the structural tests alone would record "policies share execution and retain identity" while leaving unstated that they disagree under signal and why.

Precedent worth avoiding: Epic 0A closed without the subtraction receipt its own acceptance required (bd-01KZXJMDRC6VKYX6SA38R0AAH1). The numbers above are ready to lift directly if that helps.
